# sherpa-dialog

A modal surface on the native &lt;dialog>: modality, ::backdrop, focus trap, ESC and top-layer come from showModal().

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Built on | the native `<dialog>`, which gives modal, focus-trap, escape-close, backdrop |
| Figma | Dialog |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-dialog/sherpa-dialog.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-dialog/sherpa-dialog.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-dialog/sherpa-dialog.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-dialog/sherpa-dialog.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-dialog/sherpa-dialog.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-dialog data-heading="Delete customer?"><p>Ada Lovelace will be permanently deleted.</p><sherpa-container-footer slot="footer"><sherpa-button>Cancel</sherpa-button><sherpa-button data-look="saturated" data-status="critical">Delete</sherpa-button></sherpa-container-footer></sherpa-dialog>
```

`sherpa-dialog` is opened with `show()`.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-heading` | text |  | the title of a composed [sherpa-container-header](sherpa-container-header.md); a slotted [slot=header] replaces it |
| `data-status` | text |  | status colour cascade (critical \| warning \| success \| info \| urgent) |
| `data-type` | `modal` `overlay` | `modal` | modal \| overlay — overlay fills its container and opens NON-modal, so the page beside it stays live |
| `open` | boolean, native | `false` | native boolean (read reflects dialog.open; set → show()/close()) |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | read and write | whether the dialog is open (delegates to &lt;dialog>) |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `show()` | Open it: a modal goes to the top layer with a backdrop; an overlay stays in place. |
| `hide()` | Close it. |
| `close()` | `hide()`, in the native &lt;dialog>'s spelling. |
| `prompt(value = '')` | Ask for ONE value. Its first field shows `value`; its LAST footer button answers with what the field holds, and any other button, or Escape, with null. An empty answer keeps it open. |
| `confirm(ask: { heading?: string; words?: string; action?: string; critical?: boolean } = {})` | Ask yes or no. `words` go in its first paragraph and `action` on its LAST footer button, critical when the ACTION is; what is not given stays as the markup wrote it. True for the action, false for anything else. |

## Commands

A button with `commandfor` set to this element's id sends these as its `command`:

| Command | Calls |
|---|---|
| `--show` | `show()` |
| `--hide` | `hide()` |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `header` | header | header region (reflects has-header): a header of its own, in place of data-heading's |
| (default) | content | the dialog body |
| `footer` | footer | footer region (reflects has-footer) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`body`, `footer`, `header`, `heading`, `root`
